description: Task rows inherit their due date from the nearest thing above them that has one — a dated day-row (Bike's own Calendar panel id when present, works with any day-title format or locale, or a leading YYYY-MM-DD in a hand-typed heading's title otherwise), or a closer parent task/heading that itself carries a due date, so sub-tasks follow whichever due date is nearest and cascade automatically when it changes. A due date you set or clear by hand — even on a task that was previously auto-dated — always wins.
author: Art Currim
